internal_discovery.plain_explanation: All 13 occurrences concern what persons or souls crave, whether the object is lawful, unlawful, worldly, or eschatological. Verbs profile directed desiring; nouns profile the appetite or its pursued objects.

internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: Paradisal uses are positive while following appetites can be condemned; the polarity shift confirms that the root supplies appetite, not moral judgment.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The core is illicit lust; positive desired objects in Paradise refute that restriction.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinct from intending or choosing because $hw foregrounds appetitive pull, often assigned to the self.
internal_discovery.rationale: A narrow appetitive-direction nucleus is explicit across every verbal and nominal occurrence.
